title: Admin Dashboard
dashboardSubtitle: Everything across all schools and users
schoolsSubtitle: Manage registered schools and their status
usersSubtitle: View and manage every user across all schools — admins, staff, students, and guardians.
rolesSubtitle: RBAC roles and their resource permissions
auditSubtitle: System audit trail for key entities
featuresSubtitleSuperAdmin: Turn modules on or off for each school. Only the platform owner can change a switch. Schools see the same list on Billing.
featuresSubtitleSchool: These modules are set by the platform owner.
websitesSubtitle: Pre-built school website designs available when onboarding a new school. Preview any template live, then assign it during school setup. To edit a specific school's site, open that school from Schools.
noSchoolsDesc: Until a school is on this list, there's nothing to approve or support—add the first one.
noRolesDesc: Default roles are seeded during migration
noAuditDesc: Changes to tracked tables will appear here
schoolsBillingHint: Toggle “Payment off” on any school for complimentary access. Everyone else uses the fixed $350 plan.
billingPlanFixed: Plan price is fixed at ${amount} USD (set in Stripe — not editable per school).
billingExemptLabel: Turn payment off for this school
billingExemptHintOn: This sub-account has complimentary access. Uncheck to require the $350 plan.
billingExemptHintOff: This school must subscribe to the fixed $350 plan (or stay locked).
billingExemptOnToast: Payment turned off — school has complimentary access
billingExemptOffToast: Payment required — school must subscribe to the $350 plan
administrationDesc: Approve, suspend, or remove this school from the platform.
currencyDescription: Choose the currency shown on fees, expenses, payroll, and parent payment screens. Defaults to US Dollars.
customizeWebsiteSubtitle: Customize every section of the public school website.
templatePickerHint: Choose a pre-built website design. Each template includes a public homepage and admissions path.
dnsInstructions: We'll provide DNS instructions to connect
schoolCreatedToast: School created. Enable their public site from the academic dashboard when ready.
urlSlugHint: Used in the public site URL
addSchoolFirst: Add a school before creating branches.
tryDifferentSearch: Try a different search term or role filter.
publicSiteEnabledHint: When disabled, the school website is hidden from visitors
deleteSchoolConfirm: Delete "{name}"? This permanently removes the school and all related data (branches, students, staff, finances, etc.). This cannot be undone.
noUsersYetDesc: Users will appear here once schools onboard staff, students, and guardians.
afterSavingLanguage: After saving, every screen in the app uses {language} only.
selectSchoolModules: Choose a school, then turn modules on or off. A module that is off disappears from that school's sidebar.
featuresReadOnly: You can review this list. Only the platform owner can change a switch.
releasesSubtitle: Each card is a feature already built and walked through. Approve puts it into the live app. Then turn it on per school under Features.
awaitingReleasesSubtitle: Approve a feature here to merge it into the live app. Leave it and schools keep working without it.
noReleasesWaiting: Nothing is waiting. The next finished feature will land here and in your notifications.
noReleasesWaitingDetail: This is normal when the queue is empty — not a bug. A card appears after GitHub Actions finishes on a pull request labeled daily-feature (tour recorded, then published to this inbox). You also get a notification when you are logged in as the platform owner.
releasesLoadError: Could not load the release queue. Apply migration 00069_product_releases.sql on Supabase, then refresh.
releasesOwnerOnlyHint: You are signed in as super admin, but Approve and Dismiss are only for the platform owner (pascodinamic00@gmail.com). Switch accounts to approve features.
approveReleaseHint: Approve merges the pull request into production. Dismiss closes it and leaves the feature off.
releaseApproved: Approved. It is merging into the live app.
releaseDismissed: Dismissed. The pull request is closed.
releaseDismissedPrOpen: Dismissed here. The pull request stayed open because GitHub is not connected.
releaseFeatureKey: Module key: {key}. After it is live, turn it on per school under Features.
selectSchoolToManage: Select a school to manage its features.
